Billy releases Daniel and Arthur then yields sole exterior to Chris. Chris remains exterior at end.

Captain Sorell retreats to signal station with two survivors via horse; some wounded soldiers survive.
Chris takes one bent ordinary field-gun sighting assembly; no new weapon mechanism or repair completed.
Group crosses magnetically held bridge; no payment; Magneto remains with refugees and dismantles access to impede pursuit.
No gang property seizure/loot cash; old common coin allocation unchanged.
